answer: To shield agent networks from identity fraud, each participant must lock up a valuable economic bond before trading. If immutable on-ledger evidence reveals a single entity generating an echo of coordinated sybil accounts, the protocol automatically burns those staked assets. This sharp financial ridge ensures that even if a gale of automated clones attempts to corrupt consensus, the attacker suffers catastrophic losses. Consequently, holding collateral hostage makes spoofing cost-prohibitive.
